name: Fortis Healthcare
about: Fortis Healthcare Limited, part of the IHH Healthcare Berhad group, is one of India's largest integrated healthcare providers. With 28 healthcare facilities, over 4,500 operational beds, and 400+ diagnostics centers, Fortis offers a full spectrum of services from clinics to advanced quaternary care. The company operates in India, the UAE, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, delivering world-class patient care and clinical excellence. Listed on the BSE and NSE in India, Fortis leverages its global partnership with IHH to continually enhance its healthcare offerings. Employing around 23,000 people, including those at Agilus Diagnostics Limited, Fortis is committed to becoming the world’s most trusted healthcare network.
